Theorem
[Comparison with an infinite normal derivative] 1. ch14:14.10\group ch14-boundary-gradient Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0359 Let $\Omega $ be bounded and $\Gamma $ a relatively open $C^1$ portion of $\partial \Omega $. Let $Q$ be elliptic of the form (14.2). If $u\in C^0(\overline\Omega )\cap C^2(\Omega \cup \Gamma )$ and $v\in C^0(\overline\Omega )\cap C^2(\Omega )$ satisfy $Qu\geq Qv$ in $\Omega $, $u\leq v$ on $\partial \Omega \setminus \Gamma $, and $\partial v/\partial u =-\infty $ on $\Gamma $, then $u\leq v$ in $\Omega $.
Proof

\sketch Theorem 10.1 bounds $\sup _\Omega (u-v)$ by its positive boundary maximum on $\Gamma $. Since $\partial _ u (u-v)=+\infty $ there, such a maximum cannot occur; hence $u-v\leq 0$.

□

For $y\in \partial \Omega $, $\delta =\diam \Omega $, and $w=m+\psi (r)$, $r=|x-y|$, with $\psi (\delta )=0$, $\psi '\leq 0$, and $\psi '(a)=-\infty $, egin{equation} \overline Qw = rac{\psi '}r(\mathcal T-\mathcal E^*) + rac{\psi ''}{(\psi ')^2}\mathcal E+b. ag {14.62} \end{equation} Whenever this is negative on $\{ r>a,\ |u|>M\} $, Theorem 14.10 gives egin{equation} \sup _{\Omega \setminus B_a(y)}u\leq M+m+\psi (a), \qquad m=\sup _{\partial \Omega \setminus B_a(y)}u^+. ag {14.63} \end{equation}

One sufficient condition is egin{equation} b\leq -|p|^ heta \mathcal E ag {14.64} \end{equation} for $|z|\geq M$, $|p|\geq L$, with profile egin{equation} \psi (r)=K igl((\delta -a)^ eta -(r-a)^ eta igr), \qquad eta = rac{ heta }{1+ heta }. ag {14.65} \end{equation} Another is egin{equation} b\leq 0,\qquad \mathcal E\leq \mu (\mathcal T-\mathcal E^*)|p|^{1- heta }, ag {14.66} \end{equation} with egin{equation} \psi (r)=\left( rac\mu eta ight)^ eta \int _r^\delta \left(\log rac ta ight)^{- eta }\, dt, \qquad eta = rac1{1+ heta }, ag {14.67} \end{equation} for which $\psi (a) o 0$ as $a\downarrow 0$.

If an interior ball $B_R(x_0)$ is tangent at $y$, use egin{equation} w^*(x)=m^*+\chi (r),\qquad r=|x-x_0|, ag {14.68} \end{equation} and egin{equation} \overline Qw^* = rac{\chi '}r(\mathcal T-\mathcal E^*) + rac{\chi ''}{(\chi ')^2}\mathcal E+b. ag {14.69} \end{equation} Assume, for $0<R'<R$, egin{equation} b+ rac{|p|}{R'}\mathcal T\leq -|p|^ heta \mathcal E^* ag {14.70} \end{equation} and choose egin{equation} \chi (r)=K igl((R-\varepsilon )^ eta -(R-\varepsilon -r)^ eta igr), \qquad eta = rac{ heta }{1+ heta }. ag {14.71} \end{equation} Then comparison yields egin{equation} \sup _{\widetilde\Omega }u \leq M+m^*+\chi (R-\varepsilon ), ag {14.72} \end{equation} and, after combining the two barriers, egin{equation} u(y)\leq 2M+m+K igl((\delta -R)^ eta +R^ eta igr). ag {14.73} \end{equation} Applying the same argument to $-u$ gives the symmetric sufficient condition egin{equation} |b|\geq rac{|p|}{R'}\mathcal T+|p|^ heta \mathcal E^*. ag {14.74} \end{equation}
